name: Cash Memo Maker
title: Cash Memo Maker Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Make a simple cash memo or retail receipt with items, discount and total in words. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: A quick cash memo for a shop or small business: add the items and print.
intro: A cash memo is a simple bill for a sale paid on the spot. It shows what was sold, the price and the total.
If your business is registered for sales tax and the sale is taxable, use the Sales Tax Invoice tool instead, because that shows the particulars the law lists for a tax invoice.
how: Add each item with quantity and rate.
Add a discount if you gave one.
Add a tax rate only if you charge tax on the memo.
Print the memo or save it as a PDF.
example: 3 × Rs. 450 + 1 × Rs. 1,200 = Rs. 2,550. A Rs. 50 discount makes the total Rs. 2,500.
mistakes: Giving a cash memo where a tax invoice is needed.

faq.q: Is a cash memo a tax invoice?
faq.a: Not by itself. A tax invoice has particulars set by the Sales Tax Act. Use the Sales Tax Invoice tool for taxable supplies by a registered person.

faq.q: Do I need the customer name?
faq.a: Not for a small retail sale. It is optional here.

faq.q: Can I download it as Excel?

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It does not file anything with FBR or any authority, and it is not legal or tax advice.
